articles.title: FAA issues nationwide ground stop
articles.description: The Federal Aviation Administration issued a nationwide ground stop on Friday afternoon, "due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety."

articles.title: Goldman Sachs looks to cash in on big IPOs twice. Anthropic’s historic deal is its next chance
articles.description: While co-leading the offering, Goldman also wants a shot at managing the billions of dollars in new wealth that the deal creates. It's not the only one.

articles.title: 10-year Treasury yield moves to 5.17% as traders weigh producer price report
articles.description: Treasury yields moved higher as investor expectations for a December rate hike by the Federal Reserve gain strength.

articles.title: Nvidia is done with Jensen Huang. The fallout in Washington is just beginning
articles.description: The Republican-led Congress wants to see Jensen Huang in Washington before Democrats take control in January.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward gains market share as slower trading weighs on earnings
articles.description: Payward’s adjusted EBITDA fell 66% year over year to $60 million, even as its share of global spot trading nearly doubled and fee-based services expanded.

articles.title: US regulators move ahead on crypto trust charters as Senate scrutiny grows
articles.description: Coinbase’s trust company received final clearance as lawmakers seek records on crypto firms’ compliance and potential conflicts of interest.

articles.title: Supreme Court agrees to hear Robinhood challenge to IPO information omission lawsuit
articles.description: The Trump administration had urged the Supreme Court to hear an appeal by Robinhood of a lower-court's decision to revive an investors' lawsuit over the IPO.

articles.title: China’s $3.2 Billion AI Pipeline Still Calls for Nvidia Chips Washington Restricts
articles.description: Chinese data center projects are still being designed around restricted Nvidia processors, even as Beijing pushes domestic alternatives.

articles.title: Hassett denies report he's leaving White House: 'Not true'
articles.description: National Economic Council Director Kevin Hassett poured cold water on a report that he's expected to leave the White House in the coming weeks.

articles.title: JPMorgan’s Bitcoin and Crypto-Linked Holdings Approach $1 Billion
articles.description: The bank’s Q3 13F shows roughly $981 million across Bitcoin ETFs, Strategy and Coinbase—likely over $1 billion counting Robinhood and miners.

articles.title: CFTC Chair Selig tells CNBC crypto industry is embracing agency rules as legislation hopes fade
articles.description: The top U.S. commodities regulator in October announced proposed crypto rules to assert its jurisdiction over the asset class.

articles.title: After Jensen Huang’s exit, what top financial advisors are doing with Nvidia: Exclusive CNBC poll
articles.description: Advisors say investors should weigh their Nvidia exposure, time horizon and risk tolerance before reacting to the leadership change.

articles.title: Dormant Bitcoin Wallets Wake Up After 16 Years, Moving $6.9 Million
articles.description: Two Bitcoin mining rewards from September 2010 moved minutes apart. The coins are worth nearly 1.15 million times their original market value.

articles.title: A trading strategy to ride out the Nvidia uncertainty and generate income in the process
articles.description: By deploying a persistent covered call strategy, investors can leverage the exact fear driving the stock down to generate robust, risk-reducing income.

articles.title: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons’ firm has deep ties to the chipmaker
articles.description: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family’s financial ties to the chipmaker.

articles.title: Retirees sometimes tap savings for one-off expenses. Here’s what advisors say to consider first

articles.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, allowing its 'dots' AI agents to make purchases for users
articles.description: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet partners with American Express, Mastercard and Visa, and those cardholders keep their existing credit card rewards.

articles.title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
articles.description: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.

articles.title: Fed Chair Warsh Wants Answers on AI Inflation—and Bitcoin May Feel the Impact
articles.description: The Federal Reserve is examining whether AI will lower prices or keep inflation elevated, a question that could shape interest rates and the outlook for crypto.

articles.title: Metaplanet swings to $170M loss as Bitcoin sale hits earnings
articles.description: Bitcoin sales, valuation losses and rising borrowing costs weighed on the Japanese company’s earnings despite higher revenue and operating profit.
